dynamical-trajectory-c7826afb.interpretation: Dynamical Trajectory: The mathematical definition of a system's history as a continuous path through configuration space over time.
dynamical-trajectory-c7826afb.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

standard-survey-4f72204b.title: Standard Survey
standard-survey-4f72204b.interpretation: Standard Survey: The method of solving for distance using one known side and two known angles.
standard-survey-4f72204b.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

invariant-inner-product-94f3d48c.title: Invariant Inner Product
invariant-inner-product-94f3d48c.interpretation: Scalar Invariant: Shows how the metric combines the temporal and spatial components of vectors into an observer-independent value.
invariant-inner-product-94f3d48c.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

the-system-mass-9d61d926.title: The System Mass
the-system-mass-9d61d926.interpretation: The System Mass: Why a hot object or a tightly bound atom weighs differently than its parts.
the-system-mass-9d61d926.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

matter-death-a524736d.title: Matter Death
matter-death-a524736d.interpretation: Matter Death: The theory that even the "permanent" atoms of our bodies will eventually fall apart.
matter-death-a524736d.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

metric-invariance-b744896e.title: Metric Invariance
metric-invariance-b744896e.interpretation: Metric Invariance: The fundamental condition that defines the Lorentz group action.
metric-invariance-b744896e.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

conservation-of-mass-fluid-90c1e2d3.title: Continuity Equation (Fluid)
conservation-of-mass-fluid-90c1e2d3.interpretation: The local differential form of mass conservation in a continuous medium.

binomial-distribution-quantum-ff10d68c.title: Binomial Probability (Discrete Trials)
binomial-distribution-quantum-ff10d68c.interpretation: Determines the probability of obtaining exactly $ outcomes of a specific type in $ independent quantum trials, such as spin measurements.
binomial-distribution-quantum-ff10d68c.symmetry_origin: The exchange symmetry of identically prepared, non-interacting systems in an ensemble.
binomial-distribution-quantum-ff10d68c.limits_and_boundary: Converges to a Gaussian distribution in the limit of large N, mirroring the transition to macroscopic classicality.

higgs-gauge-interaction-vertex-d2758ca0.title: Higgs-Gauge Boson Vertex
higgs-gauge-interaction-vertex-d2758ca0.interpretation: Defines the coupling strength between the Higgs boson and the massive gauge bosons (, Z$), which is proportional to the square of the boson mass.
higgs-gauge-interaction-vertex-d2758ca0.symmetry_origin: The kinetic term of the scalar doublet after spontaneous symmetry breaking.
higgs-gauge-interaction-vertex-d2758ca0.limits_and_boundary: Explains why the Higgs prefers to decay into ^*$ or ^*$ at high energy scales.

keplerian-rotation-profile-disk-5e4ca4fc.title: Keplerian Rotation Velocity
keplerian-rotation-profile-disk-5e4ca4fc.interpretation: Describes the azimuthal velocity of a fluid element in a geometrically thin disk, where the centrifugal force exactly balances the point-source gravitational pull.
keplerian-rotation-profile-disk-5e4ca4fc.symmetry_origin: The stationarity of circular orbits in a spherically symmetric potential.
keplerian-rotation-profile-disk-5e4ca4fc.limits_and_boundary: Forms the baseline for differential rotation; deviations indicate the presence of significant radial pressure gradients or magnetic torques.

structural-realism-invariance-mapping-8a.title: Structural Realism Invariance
structural-realism-invariance-mapping-8a.interpretation: Describes the preservation of mathematical structures and relational symmetries across theoretical revolutions, even when the underlying ontologies are discarded.
structural-realism-invariance-mapping-8a.symmetry_origin: The robustness of differential equations and group structures across centuries of theory change.
structural-realism-invariance-mapping-8a.limits_and_boundary: Provides a 'middle way' that survives the challenge of Pessimistic Meta-Induction by identifying reality with structure rather than entities.

maxwells-equations-vacuum-formalism-c392.title: Maxwell's Equations (Vacuum)
maxwells-equations-vacuum-formalism-c392.interpretation: Describes the self-sustaining oscillation of electric and magnetic fields in the vacuum, establishing the existence of electromagnetic radiation.
maxwells-equations-vacuum-formalism-c392.symmetry_origin: The U(1) gauge invariance of the interaction vacuum.
maxwells-equations-vacuum-formalism-c392.limits_and_boundary: In the limit where the speed of light is treated as infinite, the equations decouple into independent electrostatics and magnetostatics.
